name: Application listing core entity fields reconcile with authoritative API data
description:
Objective: Application listing core entity fields reconcile with authoritative API data.
Preconditions: Open Applications with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Applications.
2. Application listing core entity fields reconcile with authoritative API data.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Every first-page row shows the core fields of its own API record.
descriptionHtml:
Objective: Application listing core entity fields reconcile with authoritative API data.
Preconditions: Open Applications with the configured test data.
Steps:

  1. Open Applications.
  2. Application listing core entity fields reconcile with authoritative API data.
  3. Observe the resulting state.
    Expected: Every first-page row shows the core fields of its own API record.
statusMessage:
AssertionError: Applications row view does not show the API values of the same records (two consecutive snapshots): {'APP-2026-001182': {'Created On': {'api': 'Nov 1, 2026', 'ui': 'Nov 2, 2026'}}, 'APP-2026-001173': {'Created On': {'api': 'Oct 31, 2026', 'ui': 'Nov 1, 2026'}}}
assert not {'APP-2026-001173': {'Created On': {'api': 'Oct 31, 2026', 'ui': 'Nov 1, 2026'}}, 'APP-2026-001182': {'Created On': {'api': 'Nov 1, 2026', 'ui': 'Nov 2, 2026'}}}
